title: Hide/Show Master Objects (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Hide/Show Master Objects applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Hide/Show Master Objects (BtnHideMasterObjects) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Hide Master Objects flips and restores the real slide master visibility in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Hide Master Objects bounded Hide action sets the slide DisplayMasterShapes to msoFalse (hidden), the bounded Show action restores the original state, both invocations report execution, the slide shape count is unchanged, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.
